title: The DOM XSS scanner (2015, directly mentored)
description: The DOM XSS Scanner entry in the Student Hall of Fame and the history of the domxss add-on in zap-extensions.

chapters.title: August 2015: the first commit
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists DOM XSS Scanner (Aabha Biyani) in 2015 with program "Direct" and links the add-on's documentation page. In zap-extensions the first commit under the domxss path is dated 2015-08-21, titled "DOM XSS Active Scan rule", and is by psiinon. "Minor domxss tweeks" follows on 2015-08-24.

chapters.title: Selenium and browser use
chapters.text: The add-on page says it launches "browser windows and sends attack payloads to all of the relevant DOM elements." "Added selenium add-on for DOM XSS add-on" is dated 2015-08-31, and "domxss: use Selenium extension and add skip reason" 2017-08-14.

chapters.title: Maintenance to now
chapters.text: "Prepare release of scanner rules add-ons" is dated 2019-06-07. The add-on is still in zap-extensions: 130 commits touch addOns/domxss, including "Update Selenium library" on 2024-12-06.
